sources.snippet: Qwen3-forced-aligner-q4-k-m is a 0.6B parameter model by OpenVoiceOS designed for automatic speech recognition and forced alignment. It is a quantized GGUF export intended for edge devices and CPU-based inference environments. The model supports Chinese, English, yue, Arabic, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, Italian, Korean, and Russian, and is released under the Apache 2.0 ...

sources.title: Qwen3 Forced Aligner - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3 Forced Aligner 基于 Qwen3-ForcedAligner-.6B 的音频-文本强制对齐工具。 给定一段音频和对应文本，输出每个词/字的时间戳。 支持 CLI 命令行和 REST API 两种使用方式，支持 11 种语言，单次最长处理 3 分钟音频。 提供 Linux、macOS、Windows 预编译包，开箱即用。

sources.snippet: Novel and strong forced alignment Solution: We introduce Qwen3-ForcedAligner-.6B, which supports timestamp prediction for arbitrary units within up to 5 minutes of speech in 11 languages. Evaluations show its timestamp accuracy surpasses E2E based forced-alignment models.
